package.name: lucasCore
package.description: Builds LUCAS land-use and carbon models in ST-Sim from national datasets (FIA growth curves; CBM carbon parameters; spatial initial conditions; historical transitions and projections)

column.name: DataSourcesHome
column.displayName: Data Sources Home (one folder holding every dataset at its standard place)

column.name: EcodivisionFile
column.displayName: FIA Ecodivisions (dissolved; fields StrtmId, StrtmNm) - primary strata and model lattice; blank = the package copy

column.name: FiaConditionFile
column.displayName: FIA Condition Carbon and Merchantable Volume (USGS .Rds)

column.name: FiaDisturbanceFile
column.displayName: FIA Condition Disturbance and Treatment Codes (USGS .Rds)

column.name: FiaDataMartFolder
column.displayName: FIA DataMart Folder (state PLOT, COND, TREE csvs and FIADB_REFERENCE)

column.name: Evt2001File
column.displayName: LANDFIRE EVT 2001 (retired 2026-11-01: not read; LANDFIRE no longer publishes it)

column.name: RcmapCoverFolder
column.displayName: RCMAP Cover Time Series Folder (sagebrush/ and shrub/ rcmap_component_year.tif, 1985-2025; USGS, doi 10.5066/P138CYEL)

column.name: ForestTypeGroupFolder
column.displayName: USFS Forest Type Group Map Folder (NFCMS regional *_ForestType.tif)

column.name: TreeMapFolder
column.displayName: TreeMap Folder (TreeMap2016.tif and its .vat.dbf; forest type, stand age, site productivity)

column.name: LcmsFolder
column.displayName: USFS LCMS annual Change folder (year/*Change_year.tif; harvest, stages 6 and 10)

column.name: BurnProbabilityFile
column.displayName: Burn probability raster (fire method 2 default; FSim CONUS LF2020 270 m)

column.name: FpaFodFile

column.name: BpsFile
column.displayName: LANDFIRE Biophysical Settings 2020 (potential vegetation; reforestation, stage 5)

column.name: TreeCanopyFolder
column.displayName: USFS Tree Canopy Cover Folder (science_tcc_conus_year.tif; Forest Cover: canopy forest, recovery and stocking)

column.name: SoilCarbonFile
column.displayName: Soil Organic Carbon (gNATSGO soc0_999; gSSURGO also reads)

column.name: HistosolFile
column.displayName: Histosol share (gNATSGO map units, % organic soil; peat fire and drained organic soils, to-do 53)

column.name: WuiFolder
column.displayName: SILVIS WUI v4 blocks (folder of state .gdb; stage 10)

column.name: NccpiFile
column.displayName: gNATSGO crop productivity NCCPI, 30 m (stage 10; blank = fetched for the fitting region from Planetary Computer)

column.name: RapNppFolder
column.displayName: RAP vegetation NPP v3 Folder (rap-npp-v3-year.tif; Grass and Shrub Productivity, stage 8)

column.name: RpaLandUseFile
column.displayName: 2020 RPA Assessment county land-use projections (blank = the table the package ships; or county_landuse_projections_RPA.rds; USFS, doi 10.2737/RDS-2023-0026; Land Use Change, stage 9)

column.name: RpaForestProductsFolder
column.displayName: 2020 RPA Assessment forest products projections (blank = the table the package ships; or a folder of Ch7_LM_v2.csv, Ch7_HM_v2.csv, Ch7_HL_v2.csv, Ch7_HH_v2.csv; USFS, doi 10.2737/RDS-2022-0073-2; Land Use Change: Forest Harvest, stage 9)

column.name: IclusCountyFile
column.displayName: EPA ICLUS v2.1.1 new developed land by county and decade (blank = the table the package ships, made from the 90 m maps; Land Use Change, stage 9)
